summary: Phase 42-E2 (Home Redesign + Universal Social Share + MediaSession) verified end-to-end. 7/7 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend smoke: 6 home feature tiles render with locked taglines + routes, /play-and-win navigation confirmed, home-local-highlights present, share buttons mounted on /news (20), /play-and-win (66), /personas (10), Passport referrals tab (1 universal + legacy 'Your referral link' card), Wallet refer tab (InviteFriendForm + legacy referral card both present), LiveRadioStation (share-btn-station + share-btn-miniplayer-live:*). MediaSession API reachable (navigator.mediaSession.playbackState='paused' before user-gesture autoplay).

issues: Pre-existing React console warning: 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' (NavItem) — same as prior iteration, not introduced by E2.
Pre-existing hydration warning: '<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>' inside [data-testid=shell-desktop] — also pre-existing.

action_items: (Optional) Address pre-existing 'key in spread props' React warning on NavItem and the nested <button> hydration warning in shell-desktop (carried over from Phase 42-D).
critical_code_review_comments: feature_tiles.py is clean and concise (~107 lines). Three-leg local-highlights aggregator degrades silently per leg — good defensive style.

share.py: PointsService.award now correctly uses source='social_share' (the prior rule_id= bug is fixed). idempotency_key is per (user, source_id, day) which keeps share_events clean. Daily cap enforcement verified via direct test — 6 unique content_ids produced a cap_reached on the 6th call.

share.py /api/invite/send: Anonymous correctly returns 401 'Not authenticated' (verified via curl); voucher code is 12-char URL-safe and stored on referral_vouchers + referral_invites collections persisting to_email/to_name/personal_note/code/deep_link/email_status. Email_status currently returns 'sent_via_mailgun' (Mailgun appears to be is_live=true in this env) — spec said MOCKED, but functionally fine. If Mailgun should stay mocked, force is_live()=false via env.

InviteFriendForm: testid naming was inconsistent with spec — fixed by renaming `invite-email`→`invite-friend-email`, `invite-name`→`invite-friend-name`, `invite-note`→`invite-friend-note`, `invite-submit`→`invite-friend-submit` to match the testing contract.
